description: Upload an image, video or audio file to your asset library and get an asset:// reference to pass to video models (reference_image_urls, image_url, reference_video_urls, …), e.g. to keep the same real person or product across many Seedance clips. $0.01 per asset. Seedance already accepts plain image URLs (and retries rejected real-person images through the library automatically), so register an asset only to reuse a subject. Use only with consented subjects.

asset_type.description: Detected from the file extension when omitted.

group_id.description: Optional asset group id (list_assets shows them). Default: a group named "mcp", created on first use.

name.description: Optional name, to find it again with list_assets.

source.description: The file: public https:// URL, LOCAL FILE PATH, localhost URL or data: URI (local files are uploaded for you: images and audio up to 10 MB, video up to 100 MB).

name: upload_asset
